summary: Home in the Crater is a browser-based mission trainer where players manage a 16 week human outpost on the Moon’s South Pole or Mars’s Jezero Crater. Using real historical (1976–2017 NOAA SWPC) and live (NASA DONKI and GOES) solar storm data, players balance scarce solar power across oxygen,greenhouse crops, radiation shielding, and scientific research.It addresses space-weather and habitat challenges by turning real radiation measurements and Martian signal delays into direct survival trade-offs.   By pairing gameplay with real NASA space-biology discoveries , it makes invisible radiation risks intuitive and engaging for future explorers.And we turned this whole complicated thing into a game.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer Game is a turn based space survival and resource management simulator spanning 16 weeks on either the Moon’s South Pole or Mars’s Jezero Crater. At the start of each mission, players select their planetary site and choose from three solar-weather modes: a randomized historical period, a mission starting on their own birthday, or live solar data from the past 16 weeks.
dataRefs: NASA DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information)
